name: MCSRC26
tagline: Intel Core network appliance with dual 10GbE SFP+ and six 2.5GbE ports
description: MCSRC26 combines two Intel 82599ES 10GbE SFP+ ports and six Intel i226-V 2.5GbE RJ45 ports in an aluminum enclosure. Choose a 12th or 13th Gen Intel Core U/P/H configuration with two DDR5 SO-DIMM slots supporting up to 96 GB. A separate RJ45 console, NVMe storage, optional Wi-Fi and cellular expansion, and a built-in AC power module support configurable router and firewall deployments.

features.description: A dedicated RJ45 console uses the Cisco pinout. Optional Wi-Fi and 3G / 4G / 5G expansion, desktop or wall mounting, and built-in 100-240 V AC power suit different installations.
